model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 水木明瑟
evidence.excerpt_zh: 映水蘭香東北為水木明瑟（圓明園册）臣等謹按水木明瑟四十景之一額為皇上御書世宗御書額曰一溪清水引風涼
evidence.summary: North-east of 映水蘭香: 水木明瑟. The passage names little else; the note records a second plaque by Yongzheng, 一溪清水引風涼.

evidence.title: 水木明瑟: 乾隆九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆九年 (1744), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.236 item (1), under 水木明瑟
evidence.excerpt_zh: 用泰西水法引入宫中以转飞扇，冷冷瑟瑟，非丝非竹，天籁遥闻，林光逾生净绿。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 水木明瑟, 1744. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 水木明瑟: 嘉庆六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆六年 (1801), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.236 item (2), under 水木明瑟
evidence.excerpt_zh: 石渠引水来屋裹，盈科不息俯清泚。转机运箑凉自生，习习南熏座间起。循环无巳翻浪花，声戛涧泉溅绿纱。披襟陡忆军营众，触暑挥汗追余邪。身居广厦实惭恧，灾黎五载中泽宿。仁风广被陕楚川，乐业安宁共蒙福。“
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 水木明瑟, 1801, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 水木明瑟歌
evidence.locator: v2 p.206, under 水木明瑟; source ref 2-77
evidence.excerpt_zh: 石渠引水来屋里，盈科不息俯清泚。转机运箑凉自生，习习南薰座间起。循环无已翻浪花，声戛涧泉溅绿纱。披襟陡忆军营众，触暑挥汗追余邪。身居广厦实惭恧，灾黎五载中泽宿。仁风广被陕楚川，乐业安宁共蒙福。
evidence.summary: Poem 水木明瑟歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1801, filed by the editors under 水木明瑟.

evidence.title: Scene 22, 水木明瑟 Shuimu Mingse
evidence.excerpt_other: The building where this inscription was hung was built over a narrow water channel. In some way the current turned a revolving fan
evidence.summary: Built over a narrow channel; the current turned a revolving fan, whose sound the poems describe. On the site of the rice fields and the double-roofed pavilion behind it, 文源阁 was built many years later.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 水木明瑟
evidence.locator: from p.236, under 水木明瑟
evidence.summary: 水木明瑟: 2 dated items, 1744-1801, of which 2 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1744, last dated 1801.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 水木明瑟
evidence.summary: A three-bay hall straddling a stream, where a Western water mechanism drove fans, hence 风扇房. Near it 印月池, 钓鱼矶 pavilion, a five-bay hall with plaques 丰乐轩 and 映水兰香, 贵织山堂 to the silkworm god, 知耕织, 濯鳞沼.

evidence.title: 水木明瑟 scene card
evidence.summary: North of 后湖, Yongzheng date. Main hall 丰乐轩 by the stream, and north-east of it the 水木明瑟 hall, nicknamed 风扇房 fan house: water drove fans inside to cool the room. A Taihu rock with Qianlong's verse now stands at the Summer Palace.

evidence.title: 水木明瑟风扇立面图
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样007-18号
evidence.summary: Elevation (working sheet, ink, undated) of the water-driven fan of the 水木明瑟 hall, which straddled a stream; the 风扇 sat over the channel in the east bay.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 水木明瑟, 3x1 cells.
